newsitem.title: USA: Sportsman's Guide reverse split approved.
newsitem.headline: Sportsman's Guide reverse split approved.

text.p: Sportsman's Guide said Thursday its shareholders appoved a one-for-10 reverse stock split.
The reverse split is effective immediately.
As a result of the reverse stock split, Sportsman's stock will trade on the over-the-counter market under the symbol SGDE, it added.
The company said it believes that the reverse stock split will assist it in qualifying for the Nasdaq system and plans to file an application as soon as it qualifies.
Sportsman's had net earnings of $2,327,000 or $0.09 a share for the year ended December 27, 1996. On a post split basis, earnings would have been $0.90 per share.
The company said it believes the marketability and liquidity of the common stock will increase and the anticipated increased price level will encourage greater interest in the common stock.
Sportsman's markets outdoor, hunting and surplus merchandise. The company markets through the retail mail order catalog business.
